mapper.select: SELECT ACTION_ID, RESOURCE_ID, ACTION_TYPE_CD, STATUS_CD, PLAN_END_YMD, OWNER_USER_ID, ORG_CD FROM TB_EOS_ACTION_PLAN WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} ORDER BY REG_DTM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EOS_ACTION_PLAN ( ACTION_ID, RESOURCE_ID, ACTION_TYPE_CD, CUR_VERSION_ID, TGT_VERSION_ID, DETAIL_TXT, IMPACT_TXT, PREREQ_TXT, TEST_PLAN_TXT, CUTOVER_TYPE_CD, OUTAGE_YN, OFFHOURS_YN, DR_VERIFY_YN, ROLLBACK_COND_TXT, ROLLBACK_PROC_TXT, ROLLBACK_TARGET_TXT, ORG_CD, OWNER_USER_ID, PLAN_START_YMD, PLAN_END_YMD, STATUS_CD, ISSUE_TXT, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTM ) VALUES ( #{actionId}, #{resourceId}, #{actionTypeCd}, #{curVersionId}, #{tgtVersionId}, #{detailTxt}, #{impactTxt}, #{prereqTxt}, #{testPlanTxt}, #{cutoverTypeCd}, #{outageYn}, #{offhoursYn}, #{drVerifyYn}, #{rollbackCondTxt}, #{rollbackProcTxt}, #{rollbackTargetTxt}, #{orgCd}, #{ownerUserId}, #{planStartYmd}, #{planEndYmd}, #{statusCd}, #{issueTxt}, #{regUserId}, #{regDtm} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EOS_ACTION_PLAN SET ACTION_TYPE_CD=#{actionTypeCd}, DETAIL_TXT=#{detailTxt}, IMPACT_TXT=#{impactTxt}, PREREQ_TXT=#{prereqTxt}, TEST_PLAN_TXT=#{testPlanTxt}, CUTOVER_TYPE_CD=#{cutoverTypeCd}, OUTAGE_YN=#{outageYn}, ROLLBACK_COND_TXT=#{rollbackCondTxt}, ROLLBACK_PROC_TXT=#{rollbackProcTxt}, ROLLBACK_TARGET_TXT=#{rollbackTargetTxt}, ORG_CD=#{orgCd}, OWNER_USER_ID=#{ownerUserId}, PLAN_START_YMD=#{planStartYmd}, PLAN_END_YMD=#{planEndYmd}, ISSUE_TXT=#{issueTxt}, CHG_USER_ID=#{chgUserId}, CHG_DTM=#{chgDtm} WHERE ACTION_ID=#{actionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EOS_ACTION_ST_HIST (HIST_ID, ACTION_ID, FROM_STATUS_CD, TO_STATUS_CD, CHG_USER_ID, CHG_DTM, REASON_TXT) VALUES (#{histId}, #{actionId}, #{fromStatusCd}, #{toStatusCd}, #{chgUserId}, #{chgDtm}, #{reasonTxt})
INSERT INTO TB_EOS_ACTION_EVID (ACTION_ID, EVIDENCE_ID, VERIFY_USER_ID, VERIFY_DTM, VERIFY_RESULT_CD) VALUES (#{actionId}, #{evidenceId}, #{verifyUserId}, #{verifyDtm}, #{verifyResultCd})
